reports.title: Russell Brand jailed for more than 10 years for rape and sexual assault
reports.description:
Russell Brand was jailed for 10-and-a-half years for raping one of his fans and sexually assaulting three TV and radio workers during his rise to international fame.

Brand, 51, abused his celebrity status to prey on women and was convicted after a trial at Southwark Crown Court of abuse against four victims.

One of his fans told how she was raped as a 21-year-old by Brand in 2009 at his luxury London home, while female staffers at Channel 4, MTV, and Capital Radio came forward to reveal how they had been sexually assaulted by the TV star.

Mr Justice Bennathan slammed Brand’s “staggering arrogance” as he sentenced him to 10-and-a-half years in prison for rape and three counts of sexual assault.

The judge told Brand: “About 20 years ago Russell Brand, you were becoming famous, you were clever, and in many people’s eyes you were funny and charismatic.

“You had also become a sexual predator.”

The judge said Brand’s “status protected you” until in 2023 journalists from the Sunday Times, The Times, and Channel 4 Dispatches first exposed a litany of sexual misconduct, leading to women making complaints to police.

He said Brand harboured a “casual arrogant disregard to any woman’s right to say no to you”, while his fame meant he believed “you could act when you liked and how you liked”.

The judge said the evidence in the case also showed that Brand’s entourage during his celebrity heyday had “indulged your dreadful behaviour”.

The judge imposed a nine-year jail term for the single count of rape, and added on an extra year and a half for the three counts of sexual assault.

This video has been edited to comply with reporting restrictions, and to remove graphic descriptions of sexual acts and extreme language.

The judge's sentencing remarks can be read in full at: https://www.judiciary.uk/judgments/r-v-russell-brand/
